title: Cisco joins Thinking Machines' $2B seed round

sources.quote: The deal, which includes participation from Nvidia, Accel, ServiceNow, CISCO, AMD, and Jane Street, values the startup at $12 billion, the spokesperson said.

explain: Cisco invested an undisclosed amount in the record $2 billion seed round of Thinking Machines Lab, the AI startup founded by former OpenAI CTO Mira Murati, which valued it at $12 billion.
